payload.text: QUEUE-REARM (unit, third manual action): a PR with auto-merge on and tower/gate green is not added to the merge queue until auto-merge is turned off and on (PUT/DELETE pulls/<n>/ccr/auto_merge). Seen #55 and #60 after a red->green gate, #63 with auto-merge enabled before its first gate ended (00:01:02 enabled, 00:03:38 green, not queued at 00:06). Unit: the delivery re-arms auto-merge once tower/gate on the head is green and the PR is not queued within 60 s, and says it in the PR event log.
